articles.summary: New hosted offering removes hardware barriers to bring clean recovery and cyber resilience to enterprise NAS Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, announced today Rubrik-Hosted Protection for On-Premise Unstructured Data. The offering is built on Rubrik’s Network Attached Storage (NAS) Cloud Direct service. Customers now have clean recovery for enterprise-scale NAS data without having to buy, build or manage backup storage. "Backups mean nothing if you can’t be confident in a clean recovery, and hardware limitations shouldn’t stand between an enterprise and its resilience,” said Anneka Gupta, Chief Product Officer, Rubrik. “By taking on backup storage and orchestration directly in our cloud, Rubrik reduces infrastructure friction so organizations can protect business-critical NAS systems across vendors under one unified policy." articles.title: Rubrik Extends Cyber Resilience Across Enterprise Unstructured Data
